# cloudzero_view (Resource)

Manages a CloudZero View.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudzero_view" "engineering" {
  name                = "Engineering"
  principal_dimension = "CZ:Account"

  filter = {
    "CZ:Account" = ["123456789012", "987654321098"]
  }

  connections {
    email {
      addresses              = ["team@example.com"]
      include_all_organizers = false
    }
  }

  anomalies {
    enabled        = true
    threshold_type = "Percent"
    threshold_value = 20
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filter` (Map of List of String) Filter mapping of dimension name to allowed values.
- `name` (String) View name.
- `principal_dimension` (String) Primary group-by dimension for the view.

### Optional

- `anomalies` (Block, Optional) Anomaly detection configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--anomalies))
- `connections` (Block, Optional) Notification recipients for this view. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--connections))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) View identifier.
- `last_updated` (String) UTC epoch timestamp of last update.

<a id="nestedblock--anomalies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `anomalies`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether anomaly detection is enabled.
- `min_cost_impact` (Number) Minimum dollar threshold for anomaly detection.
- `threshold_type` (String) Threshold type: Automatic or Percent.
- `threshold_value` (Number) Threshold value. Ignored when threshold_type is Automatic.


<a id="nestedblock--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Optional:

- `email` (Block, Optional) Email notification settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--connections--email))
- `slack` (Block List) Slack channel notifications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--connections--slack))

<a id="nestedblock--connections--email"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections.email`

Optional:

- `addresses` (List of String) Email addresses to notify.
- `include_all_organizers` (Boolean) Whether to notify all organizers in the organization.


<a id="nestedblock--connections--slack"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections.slack`

Required:

- `id` (String) Slack channel ID.
- `name` (String) Slack channel name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cloudzero_view.engineering 227c50e5-45a2-464b-9fe4-24c3b356f825
```
